why: Both proposals use a tan leather sofa instead of the mustard velvet the client asked for, but B has the stronger supporting pieces. It adds colorful ceramic pots for the plants, which A leaves out, and its cushions, throw and 110 cm round coffee table suit the large room and the rug better. A's 61 cm drum table is too small, and its ivy comes with no pots. A's pillows are also pale blue medallions that don't match the rug as well as B's woven ones do.
